subject: policy_rate
update_frequency: business daily; changes announced on 8 scheduled dates a year at 09:45 ET, effective the next business day
known_limitations: A change announced at 09:45 ET takes effect the next business day. Unlike the market series, the rate is also published on holidays (it stays constant). Valet history starts 2009-04-21; earlier values are in the Bank's legacy archives

subject: corra
update_frequency: business daily; published 09:00-11:00 ET for the previous business day
revision_policy: Can be republished the same day before the Bank's operational cut-off; not changed afterwards
known_limitations: The current trimmed volume-weighted median method applies from 2020-06-15; earlier values use the previous methodology. Not published on market holidays

subject: bond_yields
name: Selected benchmark bond yields: 2-year, 5-year, 10-year and long-term
update_frequency: business daily; end-of-day yields, posted with a lag (complete by the next morning)
refresh_schedule: 11:30 ET on business days, for the previous day (CRON_TZ=America/Toronto)
known_limitations: Yields on selected benchmark Government of Canada bonds, not constant-maturity yields: a series can jump when the Bank moves the benchmark to a newly issued bond. A few dates (e.g. 2006-09-04) have fewer than four tenors. Not published on market holidays

subject: exchange_rate
refresh_schedule: 17:15 ET same day and 11:30 ET next morning on business days (CRON_TZ=America/Toronto)
known_limitations: Indicative daily average of quotes from 08:00 to 16:00 ET, not a transaction or fixing rate; the Bank says it is for statistical and analytical purposes only. Valet history starts 2017-01-03. Not published on market holidays
